text: dsh-windows-shell-policy 是 DSH Web 的 Windows 默认 Shell 插件。设置卡片可选择自动、bash 或 pwsh，并填写 bash.exe 路径。插件探测 Git Bash、MSYS2、Cygwin 和 PATH；启用 bash 后注册命令工具，支持工作目录、超时和后台任务，并隐藏另一种 shell。适合希望管理 Windows 上 DSH 命令行 shell 的用户。

dsh-windows-shell-policy manages the default shell for DSH Web on Windows. Its settings card selects auto, bash, or pwsh and accepts a bash.exe path. It probes bash locations, registers a bash tool, and hides the other shell. Users can choose the shell for Windows agent commands in DSH settings.
想在 Windows 上让 DSH 默认用 bash 执行命令。
DSH 能否按配置在 Git Bash 和 PowerShell 之间切换？
让 agent 只看到当前选中的 shell 工具。
我想在设置页面指定 bash.exe 的位置。
I want my DSH agent to use Git Bash on Windows.
How can I switch the default shell between bash and PowerShell?
dsh-windows-shell-policy 的功能「bash 探测」：插件先检查显式配置的 bashPath，再检查 Git、MSYS2、Cygwin 常见位置及 PATH；自动模式在找到 bash 时选择它，否则使用 pwsh。
dsh-windows-shell-policy 的功能「默认 Shell 配置」：设置卡片显示当前状态，并允许选择自动、bash 或 pwsh，也可填写 bash.exe 路径；保存配置后用于后续请求。
dsh-windows-shell-policy 的功能「bash 命令工具」：启用 bash 时注册 bash 工具，可传入命令、工作目录与超时；工具返回输出和退出状态，也支持后台任务。
dsh-windows-shell-policy 的功能「提示词工具裁剪」：插件按当前生效的 shell 调整 system-prompt 工具列表，隐藏另一种 shell，避免 agent 同时面对两个 shell 入口。
DSH 在 Windows 上找不到 bash 时能自动回退到 pwsh 吗？
希望配置 bash 路径后，后续 agent 请求都按新选择运行。

dsh-windows-shell-policy README · dsh-windows-shell-policy：DeepSeek Harness 的 **Windows 默认 Shell 策略插件**：DSH 在 Windows 上默认启用 PowerShell（pwsh），而 LLM 训练语料中 bash 占比远高于 PowerShell，agent 执行 POSIX 命令时错误率显著升高。本插件探测 git-bash/MSYS2/Cygwin，在「设置 → 插件 → 插件配置」提供「默认 Shell」折叠卡片一键切换 bash/pwsh，动态注册 bash 工具并裁剪提示词工具面，让 agent 只面对一个 shell 工具。

dsh-windows-shell-policy README · 成品展示：| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| bash 探测 | 显式 `bashPath` → Git 常见安装路径（Program Files / x86）→ MSYS2 / Cygwin → PATH，找到即用 |
| 配置面板 | 「默认 Shell」折叠卡片（与官方「终端 / Agent 循环 / 网页搜索」卡片同构），显示探测状态与当前生效 shell，自动 / bash / pwsh 三选一（staged 编辑 + 保存/放弃，折叠时保留未保存标记） |
| 策略生效 | `auto` 时探测到 bash 则用 bash 否则 pwsh；显式 `bash` / `pwsh` 强制对应 shell；切换下一次请求生效 |
| bash 工具 | effective=bash 时动态注册（git-bash 执行，subprocess 通道，超时 / 输出截断 / exit code 标记），终端卡片展示（对话页可点击查看命令、cwd、输出与 exit 状态，与官方 shell 工具一致） |
| 提示词裁剪 | `system-prompt/assemble` 中按策略隐藏 pwsh / bash，agent 工具面只保留一个 shell 工具 |
| 持久化 | `preferred` 写入 settings 文档 `shell-policy` section，重启保留 |
| 卸载即净 | `dsh plugin --profile web remove` 或 `dev_uninject_plugin` 一键还原（工具注销 + 提示词恢复 + junction 清理） |

text: dsh-windows-shell-policy README · dsh-windows-shell-policy：A **Windows default shell policy plugin** for DeepSeek Harness. DSH enables PowerShell (pwsh) by default on Windows, but bash dominates LLM training corpora, so agents make significantly more errors running POSIX commands through pwsh. This plugin probes for git-bash/MSYS2/Cygwin, adds a collapsible "Default Shell" card under Settings → Plugins → Plugin config to switch between bash and pwsh, dynamically registers the bash tool, and trims the prompt tool surface so the agent faces exactly one shell tool.

dsh-windows-shell-policy README · dsh-windows-shell-policy：> [Latest Release](https://github.com/LAN-TINA-WS/dsh-windows-shell-policy/releases/latest) · [dsh-plugin ecosystem](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) · [Feedback](https://github.com/LAN-TINA-WS/dsh-windows-shell-policy/issues/1)

dsh-windows-shell-policy README · Showcase：| Capability | Description |
| --- | --- |
| bash probing | Explicit `bashPath` → common Git install paths (Program Files / x86) → MSYS2 / Cygwin → PATH |
| Config card | Collapsible "Default Shell" card (same chrome as the official Terminal / Agent loop / Web search cards) showing probe status and the effective shell; auto / bash / pwsh radio choice with staged edit + save/discard |
| Policy | `auto` uses bash when found, else pwsh; explicit `bash` / `pwsh` forces that shell; takes effect on the next request |
| bash tool | Dynamically registered when effective=bash (git-bash execution over the subprocess seam, timeout / output truncation / exit-code markers), rendered as a terminal card (click to inspect command, cwd, output and exit status — identical to the official shell tools) |
| Prompt trimming | `system-prompt/assemble` hides pwsh or bash per policy, so the agent's tool surface keeps exactly one shell tool |
| Persistence | `preferred` is stored in the settings document `shell-policy` section and survives restarts |
| Clean uninstall | `dsh plugin --profile web remove` or `dev_uninject_plugin` restores everything (tool unregistere

text:
dsh-windows-shell-policy README · Configuration Guide：Expand the "Default Shell" card under Settings → Plugins → Plugin config:

| Option | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| auto | Use bash when git-bash is found, else fall back to pwsh (works out of the box) |
| bash | Force git-bash (falls back to pwsh with a notice when no bash is found) |
| pwsh | Force PowerShell (DSH default behavior) |

dsh-windows-shell-policy README · Configuration Guide：Changes take effect on the next request after saving; `preferred` persists in the settings document `shell-policy` section across restarts. An explicit bash path can be set via `shell-policy.bashPath` in settings.yaml (card editing is on the roadmap).
